lastCompletedStory.title: Add syncWorktreeIfOnMain helper and wire it as the final step of commitTreeToMain

openQuestions: branchWasMain is vestigial since CAM-133 now that syncWorktreeIfOnMain self-detects the branch. Consider a cleanup story to remove it from specifyIssueOnMain/abandonIssueOnMain return shapes (not required by US-001).
nextStoryContext: US-001 landed syncWorktreeIfOnMain in src/git/on-main.ts. Three integration tests were updated from 'working-tree unchanged' to 'working-tree synced to HEAD' assertions (journal-append-on-main Case B, issue-specify Case B, issue-specify abandon). US-002 requires a dedicated integration test file test/integration/sync-worktree-on-main.test.ts covering add/mod/del/off-main cases with git status --porcelain clean assertions. US-003 requires a unit test that spies on process.stdout.write to assert the printWarning is emitted when git restore fails. The makeHappySpawn helper in test/on-main-multi.test.ts returns '' (empty) for --abbrev-ref by default so the sync is a no-op in existing tests; new on-main unit tests return 'main' to exercise the restore path.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: git restore --staged --worktree --source=HEAD in no-overlay mode removes tracked paths absent from HEAD (handles add/mod/del uniformly). Implementation matches docs.
